skipValidation.description: If true, validation of Pkg.Path and content will not be done. User can call Pkg.Store.validatePaths, later.

validateSync.description: Applies only when if skipValidation  is false. If true, validation will be done synchronously.

dependenciesResolved.description:
If true, pkg dependency resolution with ArtifactHub is skipped. Use when the necessary dependencies are already configured,
   prior to updating a pkg decl. e.g. starting trial app with a dependency pkg version

ignoreLocks.description:
If true, all {@link FileExt.PKG_LOCK} files will be ignored, and dependencies will be resolved using only
{@link Pkg.Decl#dependencies}. All {@link FileExt.PKG_LOCK} files will be regenerated and written to the store.
